translations.web: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.
translations.bsb: They saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.
translations.kjv: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
translations.asv: And there appeared unto them tongues parting asunder, like as of fire; and it sat upon each one of them.
